.peer-ai/work/CR-4.json.title: Move a pickup to another day
.peer-ai/work/CR-4.json.goal: A customer can move their own pickup to a later day, up until the evening before, without ringing support.
acceptance: Given a customer's own pickup that hasn't been collected, when they move it to a later day before 6pm the day before its current date, then it's moved and the new date is saved.
Given it's after 6pm the day before the pickup, when the customer tries to move it, then it's refused, with a message saying it's too late to move online.
Given a pickup that has been collected, when the customer tries to move it, then it's refused.
Given someone else's pickup, when a customer tries to move it, then it's refused as if it didn't exist.
Given a new date that is today or in the past, in the UK, when the customer tries to move a pickup to it, then it's refused.
.peer-ai/work/CR-4.json.next: Check the item against its acceptance criteria before it ships.

setup.services/api/app/main.py:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.routes import assistant, moves, parcels, payments

app = FastAPI(title="Courier API")

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(parcels.router)
app.include_router(moves.router)
app.include_router(payments.router)
app.include_router(assistant.router)
